zh.summary: 改善 Windows 启动等待与桌面导航，修复工作台登录链接和插件交互，完善更新、诊断及随包说明。
highlights: 启动时保持同一层原生 Logo、加载动画和阶段说明，直到工作台就绪；去掉读秒，修复 WebView 初始化遮住加载页和重复重绘造成的空白切换。
从已校验的紧凑运行包读取内核模块，减少启动期间大量零散文件读取；亮暗主题、原生菜单、侧栏与前进后退按钮保持一致，菜单通过点击打开，支持快捷键和全屏。
图片查看器更新为 0.1.0，改善缩放、拖动、下载与区域标注，放大图片时标注保持独立清晰；会话管理器使用已发布的 1.3.3，适配已验证的 Alpha 会话接口。
就绪探测保留完整登录地址；Linux 遇到登录参数缺失或过期时提供重新连接入口，使用当前后台地址恢复页面。完整目录的通用图标行为与 AppImage 桌面集成选择现已写清。
根目录统一使用 README.txt 作为入口，中英文说明和迁移指南归入 docs/；日志历史保留 14 天内最近 30 次启动，并提供有大小限制提示的脱敏报告。
完善独立内核更新：切换通道后加载正确目录，不兼容版本明确说明原因；安装前检查现有 Profile 与插件，新版启动失败自动回滚。默认插件安装失败保留脱敏诊断，外部来源插件不会被替换成同名 npm 包。
upgradeNotes: 本版包含原生启动器修复，请使用内置完整包更新或下载完整包，保留原 data 目录。候选内核只对主动选择候选通道的用户提供，切换通道不会自动安装或降级。
knownIssues: Windows 本地成品验收与用户试用已完成。启动耗时仍取决于存储、缓存和本机扫描负载；受控慢读取对比说明优化有效，但不承诺所有设备固定秒数。官方 DSH 内核仍为预览版本，候选内核仅在独立验收通过后提供。

en.summary: Improve Windows startup and desktop navigation, repair workspace authentication handoff and plugin interactions, and refine updates, diagnostics and packaged guides.
highlights: Keep one native logo, loading indicator and status surface until the workspace is ready. Remove the timer and prevent WebView initialization and repeated chrome repaint from revealing an intermediate blank page.

Serve core modules from the verified compact runtime archive to reduce scattered startup reads. Refine theme continuity, native menus, sidebar and history navigation, click-to-open menus, shortcuts and fullscreen.

Ship Image Viewer 0.1.0 with improved zoom, pan, downloads and region notes; annotations stay independently rendered when images are magnified. Include the already published Chat Manager 1.3.3 with verified Alpha session support.

Preserve the complete login URL during readiness probes. On Linux, provide a reconnect action for missing or stale authentication parameters using the current backend URL. Document generic full-folder executable icons and the AppImage desktop-integration option.
Use one root README.txt entry point and group bilingual guides under docs/. Retain up to 30 startup histories within 14 days and export bounded, redacted support reports.

Refine independent core updates: load the correct channel catalog and explain incompatible versions; check existing profiles and plugins before installation and roll back a failed launch. Retain redacted plugin-install errors and preserve external package sources.
upgradeNotes: This release changes the native launcher. Use the built-in full-package update or download the complete package, preserving the original data directory. Candidate cores require an explicit candidate-channel selection; changing channels never installs or downgrades automatically.
knownIssues: Local Windows product acceptance and user trial are complete. Startup timing still depends on storage, cache state and local scanning load; controlled slow-read measurements support the optimization, not a fixed timing guarantee for every device. Official DSH remains a preview core; candidate cores are offered only after independent qualification.
